name: React Frontend
rationale: React apps drift into god components unless feature ownership, shared UI boundaries, and data orchestration are kept explicit.

sources.label: React component architecture
sources.note: Rules focus on component cohesion, feature folders, and shared UI dependency direction.

directories.purpose: Feature-specific components, hooks, state, and tests.
Reusable UI primitives and design-system adapters.

fileRules.name: No god components
fileRules.rule: Components should not combine fetching, validation, layout, modal orchestration, and table logic in one file.
fileRules.trigger: A component exceeds the line threshold or mixes data access, state orchestration, and rendering.
fileRules.recommendation: Split data hooks, validation schemas, view components, and workflow containers.
fileRules.goodExample: UserTable.tsx renders rows while useUsers.ts handles fetching.
fileRules.badExample: Dashboard.tsx owns fetching, filtering, editing dialogs, mutations, and layout.

moduleBoundaries: Feature components may depend on shared UI; shared UI must not import feature code.
Stateful workflow logic should live near the feature that owns it.
testingExpectations: Complex components should have behavior tests around user-visible outcomes.
agentInstructions: Prefer feature folders over dumping components into a global components folder.
